changes.message: Addition of "Don't show this again" tick box in various places
Simultaneous Pick & Assign in multiple SpectrumDisplays
1D display can be flipped to vertical
Improved handling of paths when loading data
Now supports viewing 1D spectra in a flipped orientation
Improvements to how the cursor interacts with spectral data
Table search functionality has been optimized for faster performance.
Updates to restraint-analysis table: appearance and performance
The Pick & Assign tool now supports working with multiple Spectrum Displays simultaneously
“Don’t show this again” tick box added to more popups
NEF and STAR files can now be imported even if the file extension is not explicitly provided when using the file menu
A new type of dialog box has been implemented, which includes a details section to provide more in-depth information
